admissibility_benchmark_v0_37c.boundary_rationale: Stated as an interval with traceable endpoints plus a chosen point inside. Lower endpoint is the measured spectral floor (1.3323e-14); upper is the smallest obstruction (1.2476e-03). The point inside is inconsequential because PS-1's eleven-order margin means no classification is sensitive to it.
pilot_block_reasons: run 1: report emitted L2 while the freeze derived Linf
run 2: section 6 bound dropped the a'*u_x term; and C-4 self-contradiction

retired_cases.C-4: monotone_smooth is nonperiodic by construction (tanh runs -0.9999 to +0.9999, wrap discontinuity 1.9998 vs a typical adjacent step of 0.3198) while every case declares domain_type=periodic_uniform. Retirement, not restatement: no periodic profile still measures what C-4 named. Returns when a nonperiodic action family exists.

artifact_and_lineage_v0_36b.axes_independence_rationale: Boundary preservation is orthogonal to equation equivalence. A transformation can be an equivalence transformation with the boundary preserved or destroyed, and a single collapsed enum cannot say which.
artifact_and_lineage_v0_36b.coefficient_relation_rationale: coefficient_field_action could be attached while the claim it implements had nowhere to live. not_applicable is distinct from unknown: a constant-coefficient problem has no background, which is not ignorance.
artifact_and_lineage_v0_36b.interaction_rule_growth_policy: a new rule requires a PR raising the frozen count together with an example that trips it

blocking_toolchain_pins_v0_35_day0.rationale: lint is a blocking CI job, so the linter version is part of the merge gate. Unchanged source on the v0.34.0 tree reported 102 errors under ruff 0.9.10, 5 under 0.14.5-0.15.20, and 0 under 0.16.0.

boundary_condition_support.scalar_1d_nonperiodic_pysindy_discovery: not supported (both v0.31 task paths raise PySINDyDiscoveryUnsupportedBoundaryError on nonperiodic-x)
boundary_condition_support.scalar_1d_nonperiodic_strong_residual: supported for Heat, Burgers, advection-diffusion, reaction-diffusion via compute_derivatives(backend="auto") + interior-only diagnostics
boundary_condition_support.scalar_1d_nonperiodic_translation_finite: not supported (deferred to v0.31.5 overlap-crop design)
boundary_condition_support.scalar_1d_periodic: supported (strong path, frozen weak slice, v0.31 downstream discovery task bridge, and v0.32c composed candidate-to-discovery workflow example)

compatibility_policy.python_311_legacy_line: release/v0.31.x maintenance branch cut from the v0.31.0 tag; security-only fixes for 12 months from the v0.32.0 tag, then archived

deferred: external symmetry-method ports (Ko-sparse deferred to v0.33; LieGAN/LaLiGAN to v0.33.1)
trained-model extraction layer (LieGG deferred to v0.35a)
nonperiodic finite-transform verification via overlap-crop (deferred to v0.31.5 design revisit)
The Well scalar 1D adapter (blocked_multichannel_required; unblocks only when The Well ships a scientifically-honest scalar 1D slice)

design_comparison_v0_36c.mandatory_flags_rationale: A missing flag raises rather than defaulting to False: 'we did not think about it' and 'we do not use it' are different claims and only one is evidence.
design_comparison_v0_36c.row_resampling_rationale: Rows of a PDE-derived design matrix are adjacent samples of a continuous field. Resampling them independently manufactures effective sample size the data lacks and produces intervals too narrow by a factor nobody can state.

design_matrix_diagnostics_v0_35a.column_scaling_rationale: coherence and leverage are scale-invariant; the irrepresentability constant and restricted eigenvalue are not. An arbitrary rescaling moved the irrepresentability constant from 1.129160013 to 0.2955377896, across the 1.0 threshold, flipping the reported verdict on identical data.
design_matrix_diagnostics_v0_35a.leverage_route_rationale: diag(A (A^T A)^-1 A^T) errs by 5.634e-01 on Hilbert(8) and 6.258e-01 on Hilbert(10) against an analytic value of exactly 1.0; the SVD route holds at machine epsilon.

downstream_crash_test_v0_37d.blocking_measured_not_asserted: the entry point takes a zero-argument callable; a task that raises on call is asserted never to fire across the blocked branches, invocations are counted at zero, and the same sentinel is pointed at B-2 to prove it can fire
downstream_crash_test_v0_37d.portability_rationale: A schema shape: key sets and status vocabularies, no floating-point content of its own.
downstream_crash_test_v0_37d.shape_discriminator_rationale: One summary_type, two shapes. The discriminator is present in both and its block/non-block value sets are asserted disjoint, so a consumer never probes for key presence.

pysindy_pdelibrary_task.multi_trajectory_execution: supported (batch_size>1 flows through the v0.31b1 adapter to PySINDy 2.1.x list-of-trajectories fit; no silent first-trajectory slicing)

executable_actions_v0_37b.determinism_rationale: A report containing runtime_seconds cannot be byte-reproducible. Whole-dictionary equality could only pass by excluding the timing it claims to carry.
executable_actions_v0_37b.determinism_scope: scientific_payload hashed as scientific_result_hash; execution_metadata schema-stable only
executable_actions_v0_37b.domain_gate: spatial_translation refused on any domain_type other than periodic_uniform
executable_actions_v0_37b.exactness_rationale: numpy.roll permutes samples and adds no interpolation error, so a residual difference is attributable to the transformation rather than to the resampling used to apply it. A non-integer cell shift is refused, never rounded.
executable_actions_v0_37b.fitted_operator_rationale: FittedOperatorDiagnostic carries no status, no boolean verdict and no threshold. The analytical decision is computed first and alone; the fit cannot alter a verdict it is never consulted in reaching.
executable_actions_v0_37b.portability_rationale: The report is a schema shape; its numeric content is classified per field by the tolerances the caller supplies.
unsupported_scope: fourier and linear interpolation backends declared but not implemented
linear_combination_of_derivatives declared but not synthesised; reports inconclusive with a stated reason

golden_numbers_gate_v0_33e.comparison: aggregate norms only; no pinned metric is compared bit-exactly

mask_preserving_discovery_bridge_v0_33c.legacy_opt_in: before_differentiation (warns, retained for at least one release cycle)

migration_audit_v0_36a.blocked_axes_rationale: Nonperiodic data can be manufactured on both sides by cropping, but v0.22.0 has no boundary-aware processing to compare against; the weak-form path and row-selection diagnostics have no v0.22.0 counterpart at all. Blocked rather than faked.
migration_audit_v0_36a.comparator_assignable_rationale: A comparator may assign only evidence-backed labels. intentional_contract_change, platform_specific_difference and blocked_missing_legacy_dependency are policy-assigned and require a human justification; intentional_contract_change additionally requires a linked release note. A comparator may not promote its own failure into an intentional change.

pysindy_conditioning_finding.conclusion: A solve whose answer moves 21.7% when the BLAS changes is ill-conditioned. Legacy coefficient magnitudes for these two PDEs are not reproducible across hardware; the modern solve agrees to ~1e-11. Regressor selection is preserved.

residuals_tolerance.rationale: atol raised from alpha's 1e-12, which was calibrated on heat_1d alone and does not transfer. kdv_1d's fitted coefficient vector has magnitude 4.404e+01 against heat's 1.000e-01, so the same relative precision yields an absolute coefficient error 35,000x larger, propagating through |X| @ dc into a residual whose own elements are ~4e-09. Error scale is set by the largest intermediate; tolerance scale by the smallest output.

nonperiodic_generator_layer_v0_33.claim_established: interior differential-operator covariance on the overlap
nonperiodic_generator_layer_v0_33.fit_translation_generator: dispatches on is_x_periodic; nonperiodic uses finite_difference + interior-only shave at boundary_trim_width
nonperiodic_generator_layer_v0_33.polynomial_translation_svd: accepts nonperiodic input; frozen four score names unchanged on both branches
nonperiodic_generator_layer_v0_33.resolution_caveat: only Heat is well resolved below num_points=256; honest span_distance plus a low-row warning are emitted rather than a hard gate
nonperiodic_generator_layer_v0_33.verify_translation_generator: dispatches on is_x_periodic; nonperiodic compares on overlap intersect interior

pdes.external_data_readiness: readiness-only (no v0.32d external cookbook; synthetic FieldBatch supported)
yes (PDEBench 1D Burgers V8 shard 1D_Burgers_Sols_Nu0.001.hdf5, DOI 10.18419/darus-2986, CC-BY-4.0, MD5 b4be2fc3383f737c76033073e6d2ccfb; narrow cookbook only)

point_symmetry_catalogue_v0_35b.privacy_rationale: no public write-up exists to cite; publishing an API asserting the point symmetries of a PDE without a citable source would make PDELie the reference for a claim it cannot support.
point_symmetry_catalogue_v0_35b.registration_rationale: SymmetryMethod requires fit(field, ...), which discovers a generator from data; catalogued symmetries are analytically known and discover nothing.
point_symmetry_catalogue_v0_35b.validity_rationale: the irrepresentability constant is a property of the design matrix and support and never consults the symmetry; a classification derived from it alone returned the same verdict for every symmetry of every PDE.

problem_action_contracts_v0_37a.axes_rationale: Boundary preservation is orthogonal to equation equivalence. An earlier draft collapsed them into one relation_type and then needed a rule (R-A9) coupling boundary_action back to the collapsed value; with independent axes there is nothing to couple and R-A9 does not exist. The number is not reused.
problem_action_contracts_v0_37a.derivative_vocabulary_source: measured union of _REQUIRED_DERIVATIVES across all five residual evaluators, not a fresh vocabulary
problem_action_contracts_v0_37a.seed_rationale: Every v0.37 action family is deterministic. A required seed on the bundle would make deterministic actions read as stochastic and give two mathematically identical bundles different semantic hashes. Constraint C-1.
problem_action_contracts_v0_37a.treatment_naming_rationale: co_transformable_ (capability, declarative) is deliberately distinct from the v0.34b co_transforming_background_equivalence outcome label (observation). Different layers, different names.

publish_hardening_v0_36f.single_workflow_rationale: Two workflows able to upload is twice the surface holding id-token: write, and they drift.
publish_hardening_v0_36f.skip_existing_rationale: Index versions are immutable; a skip reports success having published nothing. A defect means rc2.

row_selection_v0_35c.d_optimal_start_evidence: 4 to 5 distinct optima across 3 matrices x 5 random starts
row_selection_v0_35c.leverage_conditioning_evidence: beat 8% of 40 random draws on the canonical weak matrix, against 100% for qr_pivot and d_optimal_exchange.
row_selection_v0_35c.norm_safeguard_evidence: changed the permutation on 8 of 12 adversarial matrices; in every case the guarded result matched the SciPy oracle and the unguarded did not.
row_selection_v0_35c.qr_implementation_rationale: np.linalg.qr has no pivoting parameter and scipy is not a core dependency; scipy.linalg.qr(pivoting=True) is retained as a test-side oracle only.
row_selection_v0_35c.scipy_agreement_on_tied_norms: not asserted: every tie-break is a valid pivoted QR and SciPy's own choice varies by LAPACK build; selection quality is asserted instead.
